the buffer.

the decoded content as an argument for
write_file.
Now write_file doesn't want that decoded
content though. It wants the raw byte
content.
So the fix here is simple. We pass input
buffer like this as an argument. And now
this error is gone.
Now this program will still have a couple of
other problems, but at least we got rid of
this error. And the simple core takeaway
from this lecture therefore is
that if your IDE is showing an error to you,
you should simply
analyze it, read the error description,
and in the vast majority of cases, the error
description will be pretty clear, will make
